plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for DASAN switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 6296).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the one-minute CPU utilization of the DASAN ethernet switch (dsCpuLoad1m) as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, forwarding instability, or attack traffic.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_5s
metrics.description: This metric reports the five-second CPU utilization of the DASAN ethernet switch (dsCpuLoad5s) as a 0-100 percentage. It is a short-window companion to the one-minute headline CPU metric.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_10m
metrics.description: This metric reports the ten-minute CPU utilization of the DASAN ethernet switch (dsCpuLoad10m) as a 0-100 percentage. It is a long-window companion to the one-minute headline CPU metric.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: This metric reports the total memory of the DASAN ethernet switch (dsTotalMem) as the vendor INTEGER value.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports the used memory of the DASAN ethernet switch (dsUsedMem) as the vendor INTEGER value.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: This metric reports the free memory of the DASAN ethernet switch (dsFreeMem) as the vendor INTEGER value.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports overall memory utilization of the DASAN ethernet switch, computed as used / total * 100. Vendor INTEGER units cancel in the ratio. High memory usage may indicate leaks, oversized MAC/ARP tables, or insufficient capacity.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
